meta.kural: This file is the single source for the engine and the alerts. Values do not change after the freeze. Every record must have a 'kaynak' (source) and a 'status' field. For a record that cannot be verified, the source starts with 'varsayım' (assumption).

status_degerleri.doğrulandı: Value read from the source text.
status_degerleri.kısmen: Source verified; the interpretation or unit conversion is the team's.
status_degerleri.doğrulanmadı: No NASA or official source; demo parameter. Not a medical threshold, and the presentation says so.

meta.kurallar_notu: The kurallar list uses the AGENTS.md §5 ThresholdRule format; values are identical to the nested records below. Unit mmHg. metric 'pio2' is in the models.py Metric list with contract 0.2.0 (#26).
meta.birim_notu: Pressures in mmHg. 1 atm = 760 mmHg. ppCO2 (mmHg) = total pressure (mmHg) × CO2 fraction.

ppco2_limit_1saat_ort.aciklama: Upper limit for the 1-hour average cabin ppCO2. Red threshold.

ppco2_sari_esik.aciklama: Yellow tier. NASA: to keep headache risk below 1%, the 7-day average must stay below 2.5 mmHg. An exception to the general 80% yellow rule (3 × 0.8 = 2.4); this value is used for cabin CO2.

co2_belirti_bas_agrisi.aciklama: Headache has been reported in this range.

co2_belirti_yorgunluk_bulanti.aciklama: Above 4.5 mmHg, fatigue, malaise, reduced sleep and nausea have been reported.

pio2_normoksi_hedef.aciklama: Normoxia target range, unlimited duration. Green zone.

pio2_hafif_hipoksi_alt.aciklama: Lower limit of mild hypoxia; 1-hour time-weighted average, unlimited duration but with monitoring. Below it is red.

pio2_mutlak_alt.aciklama: Absolute lower limit of the mild hypoxia range. The instantaneous value must not go below it.
pio2_mutlak_alt.kaynak: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F, Tablo 6.2-1 dipnotu

pio2_formulu.aciklama: PB is total pressure (mmHg), 47 is water vapor pressure at body temperature, FIO2 is the inspired O2 fraction.
pio2_formulu.kaynak: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev B Table 1 heading (presentation: NTRS 20220019130)

toplam_basinc_suresiz.aciklama: 34.5 kPa < pressure ≤ 103 kPa (5 < psia ≤ 15.0). mmHg values converted from kPa.

pico2_limitleri.aciklama: Daily total time limits for inspired CO2 inside the suit. The cabin threshold (3 mmHg) does not apply to the suit.

kademeler.not: Must not be exceeded. Red: return to the airlock.

giyside_toplam_sure_max.aciklama: In Rev E this was in the Table 11.3-1 footnote; Rev F does not have this sentence. Information only; not presented as a NASA limit.
giyside_toplam_sure_max.kaynak: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev E, Section 11.3 (not in Rev F)

pio2_normoksi_hedef.aciklama: The 'habitat and suit minimum' example in Table 6.2-1.

emu_referans.aciklama: The NASA EMU runs at 4.3 psia with 100% O2; PIO2 is about 175 mmHg.

kariyer_limiti.aciklama: An individual astronaut's total career effective dose must stay below this. The actual limit applied to astronauts.

spe_tasarim_esigi.aciklama: Effective dose for the design reference solar particle event (sum of the October 1989 events) must be kept below this. A vehicle design requirement; we use it as an alert threshold. Not presented as a rule applied to astronauts.

taban_doz_hizi_yolculuk.aciklama: Average GCR dose rate measured by MSL RAD during the cruise to Mars. The simulation's base rate.
taban_doz_hizi_yolculuk.kaynak: Zeitlin et al., Science 2013 (SwRI press release)

gcr_tasarim_gereksinimi_serbest_uzay.aciklama: NASA's GCR requirement for vehicle design. Not to be confused with the measurement (1.8).

mars_yuzeyi_orani.aciklama: Absorbed dose on the Mars surface is about half of the cruise dose (0.21 / 0.48 mGy/day). For equivalent dose the ratio is about one third (0.67 / 1.8 mSv/day). 0.5 is an approximate ratio for absorbed dose only.
mars_yuzeyi_orani.kaynak: MSL RAD: Hassler et al., Science 2014 (0.21 mGy/day surface, 0.48 mGy/day cruise); SwRI press releases (0.67 and 1.8 mSv/day)

doz_modeli_notu.aciklama: DONKI gives the event time and type, not the dose. Dose on screen = base rate + event effect, shown with a 'simulated' label.

o2_tuketimi.aciklama: Astronaut average for a standard mission day with exercise. Scaled within the range by activity. The OCHMO-TB-004 Rev D table (source HIDH 2014) gives 0.82 kg/person-day with exercise and 0.72 without; the team uses 0.84 (about 2% difference). The 0.49–1.25 range is not in this NASA table.
o2_tuketimi.kaynak: NASA-STD-3001 metabolik yük tabloları (OCHMO-TB-004 Rev D, HIDH 2014: 0,82 kg/kişi-gün)

co2_uretimi.aciklama: The OCHMO-TB-004 Rev D table (source HIDH 2014) gives 1.04 kg/person-day with exercise and 0.91 without; the team uses 1.0 (about 4% difference). The 0.52–1.5 range is not in this NASA table.
co2_uretimi.kaynak: NASA-STD-3001 metabolik yük tabloları (OCHMO-TB-004 Rev D, HIDH 2014: 1,04 kg/kişi-gün)

nabiz_o2_olcekleme.aciklama: A person's O2 use scales linearly with heart rate over baseline (r = heart rate / baseline heart rate): r ≤ 1.0 → 0.49; r ≥ 1.8 → 1.25 kg/day; linear in between. CO2 output scales with the same ratio in the 0.52–1.5 range (the body–air link applies to both gases).

demo_zaman_carpani.aciklama: In the demo the atmosphere and dose simulation runs 600× faster (1 s = 10 min). After an O2 failure, reaching 145 mmHg takes about 26 s. The screen says 'Simulation clock ×600'; countdowns are shown in simulation time.

demo_gecikme.aciklama: The demo does not wait real minutes; 20 seconds stand for 20 minutes, and the screen says so.

vital_karar_parametreleri._not: All are demo parameters, not medical thresholds. A decision is triggered not by one reading but by art_arda_olcum consecutive readings.

olcum_araligi.birim: mission minutes (0.5 s real time in the demo, ×600)

olasi_hipoksi.kosul: spo2_dusus ≥ izle AND cabin PIO2 < 145; if aktivite == 'dinlenme' (resting), also (nabiz_artis ≥ izle OR solunum_artis ≥ izle). During exercise the heart-rate/breathing condition is not required and is not listed as evidence.
olasi_hipoksi.oneri: Stop exercise, check the O2 supply and cabin PIO2, switch to backup O2.

olasi_co2_etkisi.oneri: Stop exercise, increase CO2 removal, monitor until below 3 mmHg.

isi_sapmasi.kosul: isi_artis ≥ izle, sustained over consecutive readings
isi_sapmasi.oneri: Monitor, rest, report to Earth; request extra measurements. Not a diagnosis.

kalp_yuku.kosul: aktivite == 'dinlenme' (resting) AND nabiz_artis ≥ izle, sustained over consecutive readings. For a person exercising, a heart-rate rise is not counted as cardiac load (no false alarm).
kalp_yuku.oneri: Reduce exertion, monitor, report to Earth.

radyasyon_etkisi.kosul: SEP event started AND (projected end-of-event dose ≥ 0.8 × spe_tasarim_esigi OR event dose ≥ 0.8 × spe_tasarim_esigi) OR cumulative ≥ 0.8 × kariyer_limiti. Projected dose = current event dose + dose rate × remaining event time. The shelter warning is given BEFORE the dose is received, not after 200 mSv is received.
radyasyon_etkisi.oneri: Go to the storm shelter; after the event, record each person's dose and report to Earth.

vital_karar_parametreleri.durum_rengi: A person's status follows their most severe decision: Normal (green) / Watch (yellow) / Action (red).

sari_kademe_genel.aciklama: Yellow at 80% of the official limit. The official boundary is only the limit value.

mars_transit.parametre_durumu: Volume, removal and generation capacities are demo assumptions; the limits are verified.

co2_limit.aciklama: Value RECOMMENDED by the NRC for 90-day continuous exposure (8,000 ppm). The Navy value at that time was 5,000 ppm (0.5%); not presented as an official Navy value. The 2018 study also recommends 0.8% for 90 days.
co2_limit.kaynak: NRC 2007, Table S-1 (90-day CEGL, NRC recommendation 8,000 ppm); PubMed 30511437 (2018)

denizalti.parametre_durumu: Volume, crew size and capacities are demo assumptions; metabolic rates are an astronaut average (assumption).

ariza_senaryosu.aciklama: Scrubber and O2 supply offline: about 1.3 h to the CO2 limit, about 2.8 h to the O2 lower limit. Computed (1.26 h and 2.83 h, verified by Barış) with the average metabolic rate, an initial atmosphere of 21% O2 and about 0.04% CO2, and T = 295 K.

yeralti_siginagi.kapsam_disi: CO ve metan modellenmez; ekranda belirtilir.
yeralti_siginagi.parametre_durumu: Volume, crew size, scrubber and O2 supply rate are demo assumptions. Normally the scrubber and bottled O2 keep the balance (96-hour supply; running out is not modeled). In the failure scenario the countdown drops to hours.

kalan_sure_formulu.not: If the denominator is ≤ 0, the remaining time is shown as 'unlimited'. In an O2 failure only o2_uretim drops; the CO2 countdown does not change. Limits are in mmHg and are converted to kg/m3 with the ideal gas law: ρ = p(Pa) × M ÷ (8.314 × T), T = 295 K, M(O2) = 0.032, M(CO2) = 0.044 kg/mol.
kalan_sure_formulu.ornek_hesap: Mars transit, O2 arızası (üretim 0, 4 kişi × 0,84 = 3,36 kg/gün): PIO2 149 → 145 mmHg yaklaşık 4,4 saat, → 127 mmHg yaklaşık 22 saat (gerçek zaman). Demoda bu yüzden zaman çarpanı gerekir.
